name: 36421 · Andalusia, AL
findings: ZIP 36421 (Andalusia) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36421 (Andalusia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36421 (Andalusia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.
